title: Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization for Model Merging
abstract: arXiv:2608.14264v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model merging combines trained models directly in weight space, offering a compute-efficient alternative to additional fine-tuning. Selecting merge parameters is nevertheless difficult because downstream evaluations are expensive, gradients are unavailable, and source capabilities can conflict. We formulate merge-parameter selection as a black-box multi-objective optimization problem and introduce MOBO-Merge, a merge-operator agnostic framework that uses multi-objective Bayesian optimization to approximate the Pareto front under a limited evaluation budget. We evaluate Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.1-8B in two-model instruction-math and three-model instruction-math-code settings using Linear, SLERP, TIES, and block-wise merge operators. On held-out benchmark partitions, MOBO-Merge obtains higher mean hypervolume than random search in 11 of 12 reported comparisons. translated_title: 多目标贝叶斯优化用于模型合并
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14264v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：模型合并直接在权重空间中组合训练好的模型，提供了一种计算效率高的替代额外微调的方法。然而，选择合并参数很困难，因为下游评估成本高、梯度不可用，且源能力可能相互冲突。我们将合并参数选择表述为一个黑盒多目标优化问题，并引入了MOBO-Merge，这是一种与合并算子无关的框架，使用多目标贝叶斯优化在有限的评估预算下逼近帕累托前沿。我们使用Linear、SLERP、TIES和逐块合并算子，在Qwen3-4B和Llama-3.1-8B上评估了双模型指令数学和三模型指令数学-代码设置。在保留的基准测试分区上，MOBO-Merge在12个报告的比较中，有11个获得了比随机搜索更高的平均超体积。对于一维线性插值，增益较小，但在其他情况下显著较大。
tldr: 本文提出MOBO-Merge，一种基于多目标贝叶斯优化的模型合并参数选择框架，能在有限评估预算下高效逼近帕累托前沿，并在多数基准测试中优于随机搜索。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MOBO-Merge, a multi-objective Bayesian optimization framework for model merging parameter selection that efficiently approximates the Pareto front under limited evaluation budgets, outperforming random search in most benchmarks.
